title: user.created (v1)
description: A user account was created: self-service registration, administrator creation, invitation acceptance, just-in-time federation provisioning, or import. created_via names the path. org_id is never set; organization membership is reported separately by organization.membership.added.

data.description: Event data. Minimal payload form (the subscription default) omits: created_via. Standard form contains every listed member.

created_via.description: How the account was created, e.g. registration, admin, invitation, federation, bootstrap, or import:<source_system> for user imports. Standard payload form only: removed in the minimal form.

org_id.description: Never set for this event type by the current server.
